logbook_meta_description: Enter a dog's record number. A record opens only for the dog's owner and the trainer.
logbook_lookup_line: The record number is printed under your dog's QR code. Type it here.
logbook_lookup_bubble: My record number is on my QR code. You'll find yours too.
logbook_form_hint: With or without “ZD-”, in capitals or lowercase.
logbook_form_error_before: That record number isn't right. It should look like
logbook_private_line: Nothing from a dog's record is shown without its owner's permission.
logbook_private_owner: If you're the dog's owner, sign in to see your own record.
logbook_private_bubble: Sorry! Only its owner can see this record.
logbook_who_title: Who can see a dog's record?
logbook_who_owner_line: Sign in to your account. Scanning the QR code takes you straight to your dog's page, with its logbook and certificates.
logbook_who_trainer_line: She has every dog's record and writes in it after each session.
logbook_who_others_line: They only see that the record is private: no dog's name, nothing else.
logbook_public_made_public: The dog's owner made this record public.
logbook_courses_empty: It hasn't finished any courses yet.
